changes.rationale: Require every schema-6 task to leave eight agent-written HTML pages modelled on Thariq Shihipar's vendored exemplars: five discovery pages committed before the first product-code commit, implementation notes before the last, and buy-in and quiz at or after it. Pages carry the shared stylesheet inline and load nothing. The gate checks presence, the inline marker and commit order only; quality is judged by an independent reviewer and the human. coordination checks only the pages a task in progress has written. The task-artifacts requirement now names its current tests. Known holes in the gate are recorded as gap artifact-gate-holes rather than claimed closed.
